verdicts.conflict: Whether state-mandated compute levies and pre-market permitting institutionalize corporate oligopolies or provide necessary structural safety baselines.
verdicts.rationale: The debate remains genuinely undecidable because it hinges on an unresolved empirical question regarding whether software weight distributions behave more like physical dual-use goods or infinitely reproducible digital information. Accelerationists and skeptics emphasize market concentration and the anti-competitive effects of compliance moats, whereas safetyists emphasize the unpatchable nature of high-dimensionality internal defects. Neither side has demonstrated how to simultaneously prevent catastrophic capability spillovers and maintain open-market decentralization.
verdicts.whatWouldChange: Longitudinal data tracking open-source model misuse rates relative to closed-model deployment safety incidents would tip the balance.
